name: amocrm-1c-resilient-gateway
description: Двусторонний отказоустойчивый шлюз amoCRM ↔ 1C: приём HTTP-вебхуков с обеих сторон (HMAC-SHA256 и/или API-token), идемпотентное хранение в SQLite WAL с transactional outbox (deliveries), отказоустойчивая доставка в 1C OData и amoCRM API (PATCH /api/v4/leads) с circuit breaker, backoff+jitter и fallback в n8n Dead Letter Queue.
pattern: Single Agent (Pipeline «Ingress → Validate → Store → Egress») with Function Calling
inputs: HTTP Webhook (amoCRM → 1C): raw body + headers (X-Signature, X-Timestamp, X-Nonce, Content-Type)
HTTP Webhook (1C → amoCRM): raw body + headers (X-Api-Token / Authorization: Bearer, либо X-Signature, X-Timestamp, X-Nonce)
outputs: n8n Dead Letter Queue Webhook (FAILED events)
SQLite WAL event journal + deliveries outbox (state machine + idempotency_keys)

components.name: resilience
components.role: Shared Resilience Primitives (TokenBucketRateLimiter, Retry-After floor, status classification)
